hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Northern Africa, bordering the Mediterranean Sea, between Algeria and Libya || mountains in north; hot, dry central plain; semiarid south merges into the Sahara || strategic location in central Mediterranean || Resources: petroleum, phosphates, iron ore, lead, zinc, salt || Exports: garments, insulated wire, olive oil, refined petroleum, crude petroleum (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mountains in north; hot, dry central plain; semiarid south merges into the Sahara || Northern Africa, bordering the Mediterranean Sea, between Algeria and Libya

climate.excerpt: temperate in north with mild, rainy winters and hot, dry summers; desert in south || flooding; earthquakes; droughts

economy.excerpt: lower middle-income North African economy; drafting reforms for foreign lenders; high unemployment, especially for youth and women; hit hard by COVID-19; high public sector wages; high public debt; protectionist austerity measures; key EU trade partner || Exports: garments, insulated wire, olive oil, refined petroleum, crude petroleum (2023) || Industries: petroleum, mining (particularly phosphate, iron ore), tourism, textiles, footwear, agribusiness, beverages
